next.reason: ALL stays optional in formats 1 to 5 (§2023:8.3.3.6.2), and §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR3 gives one character 'When a figurative constant is other than ALL literal-1', so ALL remains redundant there. §2023:12.3.7.4 GR8 and GR9 repeat 1985 word for word: the character with the 'highest ordinal position in the program collating sequence is associated with the figurative constant HIGH-VALUE', except as a literal in SPECIAL-NAMES. §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR6 and GR7 add locale, national and compile-time cases but close with 'otherwise, the alphanumeric program collating sequence is used'. For a 1985 program (no locale, no national) this is the 1985 result. The ALL-construct two-character-string statement is lexical and unchanged.
